speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) whether the Ministry has conducted a review of the 2021 study by the Singapore Counselling Services on teachers’ mental health; (b) if so, what measures have the Ministry taken in light of the survey results; and (c) if not, why not and whether the Ministry will conduct a review.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Together, these inputs give us a holistic understanding of their well-being and provide useful information to help us adjust our policies and programmes as necessary.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: It also allows us to take targeted actions to support schools that require more help.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Teachers who need support can reach out to their supervisors and school leaders.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: They may also tap on other channels for support, such as their school's Wellness Ambassadors who provide peer support, MOE's in-house professional counselling services and the external counselling hotline provided as part of wider the whole-of-Government efforts to support our officers.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I just ask the Minister, whether MOE has reviewed the report that I cited in my Parliamentary Question (PQ)?

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: In case Members are wondering, Question Time started late, so we have just enough time for one last PQ.
